svg.title: An Orbit system and its period law
svg.desc: Left: plan view of one demo system, a head process and its fifteen children on two confocal ellipses, at time zero and fifteen seconds later; inner bodies have moved further. Right: the orbital period against semi-major axis for several parent memories, clamped to 8 to 600 seconds.
svg.text: One system from the demo (family 1) and the third-law period
Kepler motion about a focus; semi-major axes come from packing, periods from T = 30 (a/3)^1.5 / sqrt(M / 512 MiB).
periapsis directions share omega = 1.05 rad, e = 0.208 (hash of the head's pid).
Third law with the display clamp
Faint lines are the unclamped law; slope 3/2. Dots are this system's shells.
